# Source: wiki:Movement steps@19723 (rev 2025-08-19T16:29:37Z); "Quarter Steps"@14388 redirects to it.

column4: on ground or in air, movement is split into 4 quarter-steps per frame
each quarter-step moves 1/4 of the frame velocity
if the quarter-step position is <= 78 units below a floor, Mario lands on it
ceiling <= 160 units above with non-negative vertical velocity zeroes vertical velocity
same 160-unit window used when checking hangable ceilings
with the riding-shell flag, water surface acts as a floor up to 78 units above the position
100 units below the water level transitions to water plunge
falling more than 1150 units from the peak plays the falling scream
effective speed = horizontal speed times the floor normal's y; shrinks on steeper slopes (wiki:De facto speed@14131)
